title: Korean-Style Perilla Leaf Wraps
description: A flavorful and crunchy Korean-inspired dish featuring perilla leaves wrapped with zesty fillings. This dish is perfect for a quick snack or light lunch.
instructions: 1. Prepare the filling by mixing the zesty Korean sauce, cucumber, carrot, and Korean chili flakes in a bowl.
2. Heat a non-stick pan with sesame oil over medium heat.
3. Add the filling mixture to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Meanwhile, blanch the perilla leaves in boiling water for 30 seconds.
5. Remove the perilla leaves from the water and immediately submerge them in an ice bath to stop cooking.
6. Once the leaves have cooled, dry them with a paper towel.
7. Assemble the wraps by placing a few leaves on a plate, then topping with the cooked filling mixture.
